content: Human-labeling session — econ-far-patch-vs-near-patch:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a patch-selection drill with seed-rotated base latitude. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), an Ore Refinery (proc) and one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) at either the NORTH (y=14) or SOUTH (y=28) latitude. Each latitude has its own NEAR and FAR patch; the harvester starts adjacent to the FAR patch on YOUR latitude. Within about 50 turns, reach economy value $5500 with a harvester cycling the near patch on your matched latitude, and keep your Construction Yard standing.
